# pve_cluster_options (Data Source)

Reads the datacenter-wide cluster options singleton (`GET /cluster/options`). All attributes are computed; unset options are null. Requires `Sys.Audit` on `/` — without it not all options are returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Read the datacenter-wide cluster options. All attributes are computed;
# unset options are null.
data "pve_cluster_options" "options" {}

output "migration_settings" {
  value = data.pve_cluster_options.options.migration
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `bwlimit` (Attributes) Cluster-wide I/O bandwidth limits for various operations, in KiB/s. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bwlimit))
- `consent_text` (String) Consent text displayed before logging in, up to 65536 characters.
- `console` (String) Default console viewer. If the selected viewer is not available (e.g. SPICE is not activated for the VM), the fallback is noVNC. Must be one of: `applet`, `vv`, `html5`, `xtermjs`.
- `crs` (Attributes) Cluster resource scheduling (CRS) settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--crs))
- `description` (String) Datacenter description, shown in the web-interface datacenter notes panel, up to 65536 characters.
- `email_from` (String) Email address notifications are sent from (default is root@$hostname).
- `fencing` (String) Fencing mode of the HA cluster. `hardware` needs a valid configuration of fence devices in /etc/pve/ha/fence.cfg; `hardware` and `both` are experimental. Must be one of: `watchdog`, `hardware`, `both`.
- `ha` (Attributes) Cluster-wide HA settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ha))
- `http_proxy` (String) External HTTP proxy used for downloads, e.g. `http://username:password@host:port/`.
- `id` (String) Singleton identifier for the datacenter options; always `cluster`.
- `keyboard` (String) Default keyboard layout for the VNC server. Must be one of: `de`, `de-ch`, `da`, `en-gb`, `en-us`, `es`, `fi`, `fr`, `fr-be`, `fr-ca`, `fr-ch`, `hu`, `is`, `it`, `ja`, `lt`, `mk`, `nl`, `no`, `pl`, `pt`, `pt-br`, `sv`, `sl`, `tr`.
- `language` (String) Default GUI language. Must be one of: `ar`, `ca`, `da`, `de`, `en`, `es`, `eu`, `fa`, `fr`, `hr`, `he`, `it`, `ja`, `ka`, `kr`, `nb`, `nl`, `nn`, `pl`, `pt_BR`, `ru`, `sl`, `sv`, `tr`, `ukr`, `zh_CN`, `zh_TW`.
- `location` (Attributes) Physical location of the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `mac_prefix` (String) Prefix for auto-generated guest MAC addresses (default `BC:24:11`, the Proxmox OUI).
- `max_workers` (Number) Maximum number of workers per node started for actions like stopping all VMs. Must be at least 1.
- `migration` (Attributes) Cluster-wide migration settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--migration))
- `migration_unsecure` (Boolean) Deprecated: whether migration may run without the SSH tunnel; use `migration.type` instead.
- `next_id` (Attributes) Range control for the free VMID auto-selection pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--next_id))
- `notify` (Attributes) Cluster-wide notification settings; several keys are deprecated in favor of the notification endpoint and matcher resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notify))
- `registered_tags` (String) Semicolon-separated list of tags that require `Sys.Modify` on `/` to set or delete.
- `replication` (Attributes) Cluster-wide replication settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--replication))
- `tag_style` (Attributes) Tag style options for the web interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_style))
- `u2f` (Attributes) U2F configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--u2f))
- `user_tag_access` (Attributes) Privilege options for user-settable tags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_tag_access))
- `webauthn` (Attributes) WebAuthn configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webauthn))

<a id="nestedatt--bwlimit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bwlimit`

Read-Only:

- `clone` (Number) Bandwidth limit in KiB/s for cloning disks. Must be at least 0.
- `default` (Number) Default bandwidth limit in KiB/s. Must be at least 0.
- `migration` (Number) Bandwidth limit in KiB/s for migrating guests, including moving local disks. Must be at least 0.
- `move` (Number) Bandwidth limit in KiB/s for moving disks. Must be at least 0.
- `restore` (Number) Bandwidth limit in KiB/s for restoring guests from backups. Must be at least 0.


<a id="nestedatt--crs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `crs`

Read-Only:

- `ha` (String) Resource scheduler mode for HA: `basic` counts services, `static` also considers their CPU and memory configuration, `dynamic` also considers current usage. Must be one of: `basic`, `static`, `dynamic`.
- `ha_auto_rebalance` (Boolean) Whether to use CRS for balancing HA resources automatically depending on the current node imbalance.
- `ha_auto_rebalance_hold_duration` (Number) Number of HA rounds the imbalance threshold must be exceeded before triggering an automatic balancing migration. Must be at least 0.
- `ha_auto_rebalance_margin` (Number) Minimum relative improvement in cluster node imbalance, in percent, to commit to a balancing migration. Must be between 0 and 100.
- `ha_auto_rebalance_method` (String) Scoring method used for balancing migrations. Must be one of: `bruteforce`, `topsis`.
- `ha_auto_rebalance_threshold` (Number) Cluster node imbalance, in percent, that triggers the automatic resource balancing system. Must be between 0 and 100.
- `ha_rebalance_on_start` (Boolean) Whether to use CRS for selecting a suited node when an HA service request-state changes from stop to start.


<a id="nestedatt--ha"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ha`

Read-Only:

- `shutdown_policy` (String) Policy for HA services on node shutdown: `freeze` disables auto-recovery, `failover` ensures recovery, `conditional` recovers on poweroff and freezes on reboot, `migrate` moves running services to other nodes if possible. Must be one of: `freeze`, `failover`, `conditional`, `migrate`.


<a id="nestedatt--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location`

Read-Only:

- `latitude` (Number) Latitude of the cluster location.
- `longitude` (Number) Longitude of the cluster location.
- `name` (String) Name of the cluster location.


<a id="nestedatt--migration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `migration`

Read-Only:

- `network` (String) CIDR of the (sub)network used for migration; used as a fallback for replication jobs when the replication network setting is not set.
- `type` (String) Migration traffic is encrypted using an SSH tunnel by default; on completely private networks this can be disabled to increase performance. Must be one of: `secure`, `insecure`.


<a id="nestedatt--next_id"></a>
### Nested Schema for `next_id`

Read-Only:

- `lower` (Number) Lower, inclusive boundary of the free next-id API range. Must be between 100 and 999999999.
- `upper` (Number) Upper, exclusive boundary of the free next-id API range. Must be between 100 and 1000000000.


<a id="nestedatt--notify"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notify`

Read-Only:

- `fencing` (String) Unused: use datacenter notification settings instead. Must be one of: `always`, `never`.
- `package_updates` (String) Deprecated: when the daily update job should send notifications; `auto` means daily for systems with a valid subscription. Must be one of: `auto`, `always`, `never`.
- `replication` (String) Unused: use datacenter notification settings instead. Must be one of: `always`, `never`.
- `target_fencing` (String) Unused: notification target for fencing events.
- `target_package_updates` (String) Unused: notification target for package update events.
- `target_replication` (String) Unused: notification target for replication events.


<a id="nestedatt--replication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `replication`

Read-Only:

- `network` (String) CIDR of the (sub)network used for replication jobs.
- `type` (String) Replication traffic is encrypted using an SSH tunnel by default; on completely private networks this can be disabled to increase performance. Must be one of: `secure`, `insecure`.


<a id="nestedatt--tag_style"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tag_style`

Read-Only:

- `case_sensitive` (Boolean) Whether filtering for unique tags on update should check case-sensitively.
- `color_map` (String) Semicolon-separated manual color mapping for tags, each as `tag:hex-color[:hex-color-for-text]`.
- `ordering` (String) Sorting of tags in the web interface and the API update. Must be one of: `config`, `alphabetical`.
- `shape` (String) Tag shape in the web interface tree. Must be one of: `full`, `circle`, `dense`, `none`.


<a id="nestedatt--u2f"></a>
### Nested Schema for `u2f`

Read-Only:

- `appid` (String) U2F AppId URL override; defaults to the origin.
- `origin` (String) U2F origin override, mostly useful for single nodes with a single URL.


<a id="nestedatt--user_tag_access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_tag_access`

Read-Only:

- `user_allow` (String) Controls tag usage for users without `Sys.Modify` on `/`: `none` allows nothing, `list` allows `user_allow_list` tags, `existing` also allows already-set tags, `free` imposes no restrictions. Must be one of: `none`, `list`, `existing`, `free`.
- `user_allow_list` (String) Semicolon-separated list of tags users may set and delete for the `list` and `existing` `user_allow` values.


<a id="nestedatt--webauthn"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webauthn`

Read-Only:

- `allow_subdomains` (Boolean) Whether the origin may be a subdomain rather than the exact URL.
- `id` (String) Relying party ID: the domain name without protocol, port or location. Changing this breaks existing credentials.
- `origin` (String) Site origin as a `https://` URL (or `http://localhost`); changing this may break existing credentials.
- `rp` (String) Relying party name; changing this may break existing credentials.
